sourceChanges.citationTitle: Accordo per l'utilizzo e la valorizzazione delle risorse
Dichiarazione di Originalità e Integrità Accademica dell'Elaborato Finale
Linee guida per la stesura della prova finale triennale

claimChanges.claimText: Microsoft Copilot Chat is listed for Sapienza University of Rome in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.
Google Gemini Chat is listed for Sapienza University of Rome in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

Sapienza's final-paper originality declaration requires students who used AI, automatic translators, grammar checkers, or data-analysis software to transparently declare the tool function and specific use, and says AI was not used to generate substantial content or automate any section.

For Sapienza CAD Psychology undergraduate final papers, generative AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini may be used as drafting support only with careful, transparent use and personal critical revision by the student.

For Sapienza CAD Psychology undergraduate final papers, the guidance treats uses such as relying on AI for bibliographic discovery, unverified citations, article summaries, critical analysis, delegated writing, automatic responses to supervisor feedback, data manipulation, fake results, or uncited AI content as illicit.
The Sapienza CAD Psychology final-paper guidance says students must attach a dated and signed Declaration of Originality and Academic Integrity to the final paper.
